The '''34th [[Golden Globe Award]]s''', honoring the best in [[film]] and [[television]] for 1976, were held on January 29, 1977.

==Winners and nominees==

[[File:Barbra Streisand - 1966.jpg|thumb|150px|[[Barbra Streisand]] — Best Actress in a Motion Picture, Comedy or Musical winner]]
[[File:Lord Olivier 18 Allan Warren.jpg|thumb|150px|[[Laurence Olivier]] — Best Supporting Actor in a Motion Picture, winner]]
[[File:Katharine Ross 1966 photo with cat.jpg|thumb|150px|[[Katharine Ross]] — Best Supporting Actress in a Motion Picture, winner]]
[[File:Richard Jordan 1981.JPG|thumb|150px|[[Richard Jordan]] — Best Actor in a Television Series, Drama winner]]
[[File:Susan-blakely-by-tiburzi.jpg|thumb|150px|[[Susan Blakely]] — Best Actress in a Television Series, Drama winner]]
